_comment: Branch protection for main, as reviewable code. (ADR-0037: 'pipeline definitions in version control')
STAGED, for the same reason CI stages are staged (ADR-0037 rider): a required
status check cannot reference a check that has never reported. required_status_checks
below is therefore EMPTY at first application. Each check name joins it after its
first run on a PR, in lockstep with the pipeline.
The three protections that need no check history are active immediately:
pull request required, direct pushes blocked, force pushes blocked.
Checks to add as they come online, matching .github/workflows/pr.yml:
with eslint  (lint stage inside Workspace checks)
with contracts   contract codegen drift, openapi diff
